name: Elias Lowe
source:
One of the "big three" at Heart Agency

Twin of Ashe, Elias makes his living as an actor.

Often referred to as "chameleon" Elias' roles often see him transform his appearance dramatically

One thing he won't change, however are his silver eyes.

[From itch.io]
